reference.code: use std::collections::BTreeMap;fn key(s:&str)->bool{let p:Vec<_>=s.split('-').collect();!s.is_empty()&&s.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_lowercase()&&p.iter().all(|x|!x.is_empty()&&x.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_lowercase()||c.is_ascii_digit()))}pub fn section_flattening(s:&str)->Option<String>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut d=BTreeMap::new();for r in s.split(','){let(left,v)=r.split_once('=')?;let(a,b)=left.split_once(':')?;if !key(a)||!key(b)||v.is_empty()||!v.bytes().all(|c|(32..=126).contains(&c)&&c!=b','){return None}let id=a.to_string()+"."+b;if d.insert(id,v).is_some(){return None}}Some(d.into_iter().map(|x|x.0+"="+x.1).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","))}
